subject: Insurance
title: HMO vs. PPO Plans
description: A short lesson to help you apply HMO vs. PPO Plans.

hook.text: HMO plans assign you a gatekeeper doctor who controls all referrals.

buildup.text: HMOs are cheaper because the gatekeeper filters unnecessary visits. PPOs cost more but give you freedom to choose.

discovery.text: HMOs require a primary care referral before seeing a specialist. Skip the step, and insurance won't pay a cent.

twist.text: HMOs became notorious in the 1990s for denying needed referrals. Backlash led to PPOs dominating the market by 2005.

climax.text: HMO vs. PPO is the core tradeoff: savings vs. freedom. Most people choose freedom, even when it costs more.

punchline.text: HMO: cheaper, gatekeeper. PPO: pricier, freedom. Most people pick freedom.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of an HMO plan?
options: Lower premiums due to coordinated care
